cohort: Mother-newborn dyads in a tertiary care teaching hospital after vaginal delivery, excluding multiple births, major congenital malformations, or those requiring resuscitation/NICU observation.
finding: The rate of skin-to-skin contact (SSC) at birth was suboptimal (20.7% for >30 min, 37.8% no SSC), primarily due to lack of awareness (82.25%).
